_doc: Registry of places to look for existing skills, plugins and MCP servers. Each entry names an adapter `type` implemented in search.py; add a source by adding an entry, add a new kind of source by adding an adapter. `ttl_hours` applies to list-type sources that are cached and matched locally; search-type sources are queried live.

sources.name: installed
sources._why: What is already on this machine. Checked first so we never fetch something we have.

sources.name: skills.sh
sources._why: Vercel's cross-agent skill directory. Search API with install counts: the best usage signal available.

sources.name: plugin-marketplaces
sources._why: Claude Code plugin marketplaces: every marketplace registered locally plus any listed here.

sources.name: goodailist
sources._why: Chip Huyen's daily-updated ranking of ~23k AI repos. Tags are noisy; useful for star velocity (star_7d).

sources.name: awesome-lists
sources._why: Human-curated lists. Parsed for GitHub links with their one-line descriptions.

sources.name: mcp-registry
sources._why: Official MCP server registry. Use when the need is a tool/integration rather than a procedure.

sources.name: github-skill-files
sources._why: Long tail: any public SKILL.md matching the query. No curation; lean on stars.
